summary.prose: Building this Story replaces how the workflow writes its four companion pages. It first widens the definitions (and the closed schemas that validate them) with optional narrative and description fields, then adds one shared page shell with a single pan/zoom script and a header resolver, then gives each companion type a small builder that turns its definition into a picture plus description tables. Finally the four renderers and the three finalize sites are switched to the new shell, completeness LOWs are surfaced in code review, and the old render paths and their tests are removed or rewritten. The docgen tool is left untouched throughout.

tasks.title: Add optional narrative/description fields to the four definitions and every schema that validates them
tasks.summary: Extend ErDefinition/ErClass/ErSlot, SequenceDefinition/participants/messages, ComponentDependencyDefinition/components (+ path), UxDefinition/elements/actions with optional narrative/description; mirror them in the four *_PROPERTY_SCHEMA objects AND the vendored closed linkml-metamodel.schema.json and adaptive-cards.schema.json; update the four *_CONTENT_GATE_RULE strings to ask for a narrative and per-element descriptions.
acceptanceChecks: A definition of each kind carrying narrative + descriptions gets no HIGH from its validate*Definition.
A sound definition without the new fields still returns [] from every validator.
The design.story and design.epic synthesizer schemas expose the new optional fields.

tasks.title: Shared pan/zoom runtime asset
tasks.summary: Add src/assets/artifacts/companion/panzoom.js: a dependency-free, transform-based pan/zoom bound to a view panel and toolbar (zoom out, zoom %, zoom in, Fit, 1:1), with drag-pan, wheel zoom at the cursor, double-click zoom and an exposed fit() for fit-on-load. Works on any child (SVG or HTML).
acceptanceChecks: The script has no external references and is shipped by copy-assets (src/assets is copied wholesale).
It exposes an init entry the shell can call with the panel/stage/toolbar ids and a fit() hook.

tasks.title: Companion page shell and runtime loader
tasks.summary: Add src/workflow/artifacts/companion/shell.ts with CompanionPageContent / DescriptionBlock / DescriptionCell types and renderCompanionPage(header, page, runtime): Header (project, title, kind badge, table Work item / Source doc link / Date / User), Narrative (context line + optional narrative), View panel (mermaid or html visual + toolbar + pan/zoom init + fit on load; Mermaid inlined only for mermaid visuals), Description tables (all cells escaped; null -> em dash). A runtime loader reads mermaid.min.js and panzoom.js and throws DiagramGenerationError when either is missing.

All table text is escaped and null cells render as an em dash.
A missing runtime asset raises DiagramGenerationError.

tasks.title: Route the four renderers and the three finalize sites through the shell, with the render-level suites
tasks.summary: Change renderErCompanion / renderUxCompanion / renderSequenceCompanion / renderComponentCompanion to take a required header, build page content via t5-t7 and render via renderCompanionPage (no more assembleShell). In orchestrator.ts resolve one CompanionHeader per finalize site (HLD, epic-Story LLD, standalone LLD) and thread it through renderErCompanionForBody / renderUxCompanionForBody / renderDiagramCompanionsForBody, replacing siblingSourceLink. In the same change rewrite render, diagram-render, ux-render, ux-integration, ux-mock-render, context-sections and companion-context-finalize tests to the new shell.
